water.note: Water, hand-authored combos first. Right, the Tide side: a winding river road from the belt to the rim, koi and moons along its bends, a small lake ring with a pair inside. Left, the Mist side: a zigzag cascade road from the rim down to the belt, moths, lyres and blossoms fanned into its pockets. The dark arm leaves the rim at (-14.6, 82.7).
